item.title: Huge sunken pavement, 15th July
item.description:
I reported this last week and it has been closed saying that the issue has been fixed. All that has happened is someone has put a fence around it. This is blocking our driveway. We can’t get one car off and the other car on! We have an electric car that needs to be charged. Please can you let me know when this will be fixed? We need to use our drive. If someone visits please can they knock on the door and let us know what is happening? Number 10 Millham Road.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 3,5, Millham Road, Bishop's Cleeve, Tewkesbury

item.title: Large overhanging dead tree branch on Hatherly Road, on boarder of 17 Belworth Drive, 15th July
item.description:

The dead branch over hanging the pavement/road could cause significant damage/safety risk of it dropped. Please can someone inform us what is the next step? Thank you.
